summary: NaaS Technology Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K for August 2026 containing unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing presents revenues, operating expenses, profit, assets, and liabilities in RMB and USD. No special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is described. The filing is a routine periodic report under Rule 13a-16, providing interim financial results only. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors mentioned. This is a standard financial update with no event-driven special situation to classify.
